cards.card_text: Now Elisha the prophet calls one of the sons of the prophets over and says, "Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead." Friend, I don't know what that oil's for yet, but nobody tucks up their cloak to walk SLOW.
cards.verse_text: Now Elisha the prophet summoned one of the sons of the prophets and said to him, “Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
